title: Zarmian
requirements: Development of realistic human actors designed for an immersive didactic simulation platform. The pilot asset required anatomical correction of pre-generated facial meshes, alignment of lips/teeth textures, and the rendering of numerous separate emotional states. The final deliverable had to include fluid idle motions and deploy as a seamless Unity package with unified material allocations.
achievements: Resolved mesh misalignment and asymmetric mouth geometries of early-stage models
Designed anatomically calibrated emotional expression keys (blinking, breathing, facial drift)
Created a plug-and-play Unity package with shaders configured, eliminating compilation friction
review: We requested anatomically accurate rigs and the delivery was pristine. Reduced our engine compile errors entirely.
